text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have a day off, so I'm chaperoning
Fine Motion on a day trip out
to the
mountains.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale... Ah, the air is so fresh out here in the forest! It reminds me of mornings in the garden back home.

text_block_list.name: Captain's Voice over...
text_block_list.text:
...That will be all,
Trainer. Please remain
vigilant, and ensure Her
Highness's safety.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, thank you again for your time,
Trainer. They certainly
wouldn't have let
me come this far out alone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's an excellent question. Hehehe,
you see...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't planned anything!
I just thought
we'd have ourselves a
nice, normal stroll in
the great outdoors.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, although, um... You never know what
surprises could be waiting
out there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I smell mischief brewing,
but I let it slide
for now, and we set off on
the path.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that was delicious! Not to toot my
own horn, but the cold
noodles I packed
came out perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And made it so far, too. No more city—just
the creek gurgling, birds singing, bugs
chirping...
It feels like we wandered into a fairytale
world.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know, it reminds me of a story I read
when I was little. The hero
saves the
princess, and they're running through the
woods together...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And then, the dragon catches up to steal
the princess back. It actually
attacks them
in a remote clearing just like this.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
It feels like the dragon could pop
out any second, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just a "what-if," silly. But if a
dragon really did jump out... You
would
fight to protect me... Right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Really?! I'm flattered! Aw, now I almost wish a dragon would appear.
GrooooOOOOOOAR!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer,
look! There's something in the
river!

text_block_list.name: Dragon
text_block_list.text: Graaaaawr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the water emerges... a tyrannosaurus
rex costume with big
flabby wings for
arms.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A dragon! Oh no! Don't come any closer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While my mind struggles for a comeback,
the... dragon(?) crosses its
arms, striking a
pose straight out of a monster movie.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Whatever am I to do? The evil
dragon is going to eat me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if only—if only a hero would slay the
dragon and rescue me from
my plight...

text_block_list.name: Dragon
text_block_list.text: Rooooar!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My hero! May courage guide your hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wrestle the dragon for minutes, getting
pushed back and forth
aimlessly until
finally...

text_block_list.name: Dragon
text_block_list.text: Groooar! I have fallen!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! You were so dashing,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But we've got no time to celebrate. The
dragon gets back on its feet
and then...
removes its head.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Three, two, one!

text_block_list.name: Fine & Captain
text_block_list.text: Surpriiiise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I am shocked and flabbergasted by this
entirely unexpected turn of
events.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Remember the other day, when
we helped take that kitty
home?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I kept thinking to myself what a nice
surprise it was, so I decided to
plan
another, just for you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...How was it? Did you like it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad!
All that rehearsal was worth it,
I see. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm also happy you kept your
promise—that you'd protect me from the

dragon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The un-dragon-ified Captain joins us for
the rest of the hike. We enjoy the view
from the mountain's peak, then leisurely
make our way
home.

text_block_list.name: Owner of Ramen Rampage
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome back, lassie. Can I getcha the
usual?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, for three, please.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whew... After all that,
it feels nice to be
back. Thank you both for
such an exciting
outing.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I've got quite a lot of practice
being
the dragon. Her Highness
even made me a
medal for it when she was little.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I remember that! The medal for
draconic excellence, right? I
made it with
flowers, twigs, and clovers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, I wonder what
award I should give our
dashing hero. How
about... "the dragon slayer's medallion"?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Dragon Slayer. Just so
you know, though, I'm also a decorated
actor of witches and fortresses.
You've not
bested me yet.

text_block_list.name: Owner of Ramen Rampage
text_block_list.text:
Order up. Three bowls of savory shio
ramen, with extra toppings.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Eh?! The savory shio ramen doesn't come
with menma or corn, and I
didn't say
anything. How did you know?

text_block_list.name: Owner of Ramen Rampage
text_block_list.text:
I remember my regulars' usual
orders—toppings and all. The extras are
on
the house, so you three enjoy 'em.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We absolutely will. Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The "usual," though... I suppose there's a
lot of charm in the ordinary
everyday
routine, too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
It's odd to think that I'm a "regular"
here now. Eating ramen and chatting with
everyone has become such a normal part
of my life.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You know, I think maybe, just maybe...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing.
I was just struck by what a
lovely day it's been.
